title.en: A 5, 12, or 16-round idea review inside Claude Code
title.zh: 在 Claude Code 裡進行 5、12 或 16 輪的點子驗證

description.en: An open-source Claude Code skill that researches an idea, has four thinking personalities argue it over 5, 12, or 16 rounds, and saves a verdict, a kill criterion, and a printable report.
description.zh: 一個開源的 Claude Code skill：先研究你的點子，再讓四種思考個性辯論 5、12 或 16 輪，最後存下結論、停止條件與可列印的報告。

eyebrow.zh: Claude Code skill · 點子驗證

headline.en: Pressure-test the idea before you build it.
headline.zh:
先挑戰點子，
再決定做不做。

lede.en: Ask Claude Code to validate an idea. Four thinking personalities argue it over 5, 12, or 16 rounds, and Codex, Gemini, or Grok add their own analysis when their CLIs answer. You get a verdict with a kill criterion.
lede.zh: 請 Claude Code 驗證一個點子，四種思考個性會辯論 5、12 或 16 輪；Codex、Gemini、Grok 的 CLI 能回應時，也會加入各自的分析。最後你拿到的是附停止條件的結論。

notes.en: Made for the 自由工坊 community

meta.en: 3 optional providers · 45 s per smoke test
meta.zh: 3 個選配 provider · 每個測試 45 秒逾時

rows.detail: grok cli not found · Claude 模擬 Grok

left.en: Asks once for keys, never blocks
left.zh: key 只問一次，不會卡住

title.zh: 先研究，再辯論，最後下決定。

body.en: check_providers.py looks for codex, agy or gemini, and grok, and sends each one a one-line prompt. If a CLI is installed but cannot answer, Claude reports it as 測不到帳號 (account not reachable).
body.zh: check_providers.py 會找 codex、agy 或 gemini，以及 grok，並各送一句測試提示。裝了卻無法回應的 CLI，Claude 會回報「測不到帳號」。

body.en: With web tools available, Claude gathers competitors, pricing, demand, platform limits, and policy constraints. Later rounds must separate evidence from assumptions.
body.zh: 有網路工具時，Claude 會先蒐集競品、價格、需求、平台限制與政策限制。之後每一輪都要分清楚哪些是證據、哪些是假設。

body.en: Round 1 is first positions, the middle rounds clash, and the last round converges. After round 1, every personality must answer an earlier point.
body.zh: 第 1 輪各自表態，中間幾輪互相攻防，最後一輪收斂。第 1 輪之後，每個個性都要回應先前的論點。

body.en: final.md holds the verdict, confidence, and kill criterion. report.html shows the conclusion first, then the idea and every round, with a Print / Save PDF button.
body.zh: final.md 記下結論、信心分數與停止條件；report.html 先放結論，接著是點子與每一輪，並附上 Print / Save PDF 按鈕。

title.zh: 要的是決策依據，不是加油打氣。

intro.en: Most of the skill is instructions in SKILL.md. Three small Python scripts handle the mechanical parts: the provider check, the review folder, and the report.
intro.zh: 這個 skill 大部分是 SKILL.md 裡的指示；三個小型 Python scripts 負責機械性的部分：provider 檢查、review 資料夾與報告。

title.zh: 四種個性，不是四個模型

body.en: Optimist, Skeptic, Pragmatist, and Synthesizer are thinking styles, not departments, roles, or separate models. Each gets its own section in every round file.
body.zh: Optimist、Skeptic、Pragmatist、Synthesizer 是思考風格，不是部門、職務，也不是不同的模型。每一輪的檔案裡，各自都有一段。

title.en: Native when possible, labeled when simulated
title.zh: 能用原生就用，模擬時會標明

body.en: Codex, Gemini, and Grok are used through their CLIs when they answer. Otherwise Claude asks once for an API key; without one, it simulates that style and labels it, as in Claude 模擬 Codex (Claude simulating Codex).
body.zh: Codex、Gemini、Grok 的 CLI 能回應時就直接使用；不行的話，Claude 只問一次 API key，沒有 key 就模擬該風格並標示出來，例如「Claude 模擬 Codex」。

body.en: Unless you ask for inline-only output, each review writes input.md, one file per round, final.md, report.md, and a static report.html you can print or save as PDF.
body.zh: 除非你只要在對話裡看結果，每次 review 都會寫出 input.md、每輪一個檔案、final.md、report.md，以及可以列印或存成 PDF 的靜態 report.html。

title.en: Why it is shaped this way.

title.zh: 用思考個性，而不是模型席位

body.en: The web version, ai-brainstorming, gives five models a seat each through OpenRouter. Inside Claude Code, four personalities need no extra accounts, and other providers are used only when their CLI answers or you give a key.
body.zh: 網頁版的 ai-brainstorming 透過 OpenRouter 讓五個模型各坐一席。在 Claude Code 裡，四種思考個性不需要額外帳號，其他 provider 只在 CLI 能回應或你提供 key 時才會用到。

body.en: A missing key should not stall a review. The skill asks one time whether you have a key and whether you prefer the provider's own API or OpenRouter; if none is given, it continues on Claude simulation instead of waiting.
body.zh: 缺 key 不該讓整個 review 停下來。這個 skill 只會問一次：你有沒有 key、要用原廠 API 還是 OpenRouter；沒有提供，就改用 Claude 模擬繼續跑，不會一直等。

body.en: The report opens with the verdict and kill criterion, so a reader who stops after one page still gets the decision. The rounds follow as the supporting record.
body.zh: 報告一開頭就是結論與停止條件，只看第一頁的人也拿得到決定；每一輪的內容放在後面，當作佐證紀錄。

intro.en: You need Claude Code and Python 3.8+. A running session picks up the skill without a restart; if ~/.claude/skills/ is new, run /reload-skills once.
intro.zh: 需要 Claude Code 與 Python 3.8 以上。正在執行的 session 不必重開就會載入這個 skill；如果 ~/.claude/skills/ 是新建立的，執行一次 /reload-skills。

label.zh: 英文 README 完整說明

body.en: Clone into your personal skills folder. For one project only, use that project's .claude/skills/ instead. On Windows, the README has a PowerShell version.
body.zh: clone 到個人的 skills 資料夾；只想用在單一專案的話，改放到該專案的 .claude/skills/。Windows 的 PowerShell 版本請看 README。

body.en: The skill triggers from its description, or call it with /idea-review-panel. Ask for 12 or 16 rounds for a deeper review.
body.zh: skill 會依描述自動觸發，也可以用 /idea-review-panel 直接呼叫。想更深入，就指定 12 或 16 輪。

steps.code:
幫我驗證這個點子：<你的 idea>
Validate this idea: <your idea>

body.en: Claude replies with the verdict and the file paths. Open report.html in the .idea-review/ folder to print it or save it as PDF.
body.zh: Claude 會回覆結論與檔案路徑。打開 .idea-review/ 裡的 report.html，就能列印或存成 PDF。

intro.en: Built over six commits from June 14 to 16, 2026, as an open-source skill for the 自由工坊 Discord community and the 個人 IP 陪跑計畫. The skill has not changed since, and there are no releases; install from main.
intro.zh: 這是 2026 年 6 月 14 日到 16 日、共 6 個 commit 寫成的開源 skill，為「自由工坊」Discord 社群與個人 IP 陪跑計畫而做。之後 skill 本身沒有再更新，也沒有 release，請直接從 main 安裝。

works.en: init_review.py creates the timestamped folder, input.md, one file per round, and final.md; --rounds accepts only 5, 12, or 16
works.zh: init_review.py 會建立帶時間戳記的資料夾、input.md、每輪一個檔案與 final.md；--rounds 只接受 5、12、16

works.en: render_report.py writes report.md and a static report.html with a Print / Save PDF button and a page break between parts
works.zh: render_report.py 會寫出 report.md 與靜態的 report.html，附 Print / Save PDF 按鈕，各部分之間會分頁

works.en: check_providers.py finds codex, agy or gemini, and grok on PATH, and lists key variable names without their values
works.zh: check_providers.py 能在 PATH 上找到 codex、agy 或 gemini，以及 grok，而且只列出 key 變數名稱、不印出值

works.en: --smoke counts a CLI as answering only when it exits 0 with output; checked with stub CLIs
works.zh: --smoke 只有在 CLI 以結束碼 0 結束、而且有輸出時才算通過；已用 stub CLI 測過

works.en: Chinese ideas keep their characters in the folder name
works.zh: 中文點子的資料夾名稱會保留中文字

works.en: The scripts use only the Python standard library
works.zh: scripts 只用 Python 標準函式庫

limits.en: The review is instructions in SKILL.md, not code, so its structure and quality depend on Claude following them
limits.zh: review 是 SKILL.md 裡的指示，不是程式碼，結構與品質取決於 Claude 有沒有照做

limits.en: No API client: if you provide a key, how the API gets called is left to Claude in that session
limits.zh: 沒有 API 用戶端：提供 key 之後怎麼呼叫 API，交給當下 session 裡的 Claude

limits.en: A failed agy smoke test is inconclusive, because agy -p can exit 0 with empty output when piped
limits.zh: agy 測試失敗不能下定論，因為 agy -p 在管線中可能以結束碼 0 結束卻沒有輸出

limits.en: The report renderer does not support tables or code blocks, and always marks the HTML as zh-Hant
limits.zh: 報告產生器不支援表格與程式碼區塊，HTML 也一律標示為 zh-Hant

intro.en: Two scripts create the folder and the report. Claude writes the research and the arguments.
intro.zh: 兩個腳本負責建立資料夾和報告。研究和論點由 Claude 寫入。

note.en: The skill runs when you ask Claude Code to validate an idea, or when you call /idea-review-panel, and it defaults to 5 rounds.
note.zh: 在 Claude Code 裡請它驗證一個點子，或呼叫 /idea-review-panel，就會用到這個 skill，預設 5 輪。

note.en: init_review.py creates a timestamped folder under .idea-review, with input.md, one empty round file, and final.md.
note.zh: init_review.py 在 .idea-review 下建立帶時間的資料夾，裡面有 input.md、每輪一個空檔，以及 final.md。

note.en: SKILL.md tells Claude to save web research in input.md or round-01.md when tools exist, then fill the empty personality headings.
note.zh: SKILL.md 要 Claude 在有工具時把網頁研究寫進 input.md 或 round-01.md，再填上原本空白的個性標題。

note.en: render_report.py writes report.md and report.html from those files and does not invent the verdict.
note.zh: render_report.py 用那些檔案寫出 report.md 和 report.html，不會自己編造結論。

caption.en: init_review.py names the folder with the current time and a slug from the first eight words of the idea, keeping Chinese characters and cutting at 64 characters. It writes the headings only. Claude is instructed to fill them, and render_report.py only assembles files that already exist.
caption.zh: init_review.py 用目前時間和點子前八個詞組成資料夾名稱，中文字會保留，並切到 64 字。它只寫標題。Claude 依照指示填內容，render_report.py 只組裝已經存在的檔案。

intro.en: The smoke test reports which optional CLIs answer. The skill does not stop to wait for a key.
intro.zh: 短句探測會回報哪些選用 CLI 有回答。這個 skill 不會停下來等金鑰。

note.en: With --smoke, codex is run as exec, agy or else gemini is run with -p, and grok is run with -p, and a pass needs exit 0 plus output within 45 seconds.
note.zh: 加上 --smoke 時，codex 用 exec，優先用 agy、否則用 gemini，兩者都帶 -p，grok 也帶 -p；要在 45 秒內以結束碼 0 並有輸出才算通過。

note.en: SKILL.md tells Claude to say 測不到帳號 when a CLI exists but does not answer, to ask once about a key, and then to continue.
note.zh: SKILL.md 要 Claude 在 CLI 存在但沒有回答時說測不到帳號，金鑰只問一次，然後繼續。

caption.en: The highlighted lane is the fallback: without a key, Claude simulates that provider and labels it, for example Claude 模擬 Grok. Vendor API and OpenRouter are used only if you give a key, and this repo has no API client. A failed agy smoke test is inconclusive, because agy -p can exit 0 with empty output when it is not attached to a terminal.
caption.zh: 反白的路線是退路：沒有金鑰時，Claude 會模擬該提供者並標明，例如 Claude 模擬 Grok。只有你提供金鑰時才走提供者 API 或 OpenRouter，而這個 repo 沒有 API 用戶端。agy 的探測失敗不能當成定論，因為 agy -p 在沒有終端機時可能以結束碼 0 結束卻沒有輸出。

intro.en: The review folder is local. A smoke test is the step that hands a prompt to a CLI.
intro.zh: 審查資料夾在本機。短句探測是把提示交給 CLI 的那一步。

note.en: The review files stay in the working directory, and check_providers.py prints key names but never their values.
note.zh: 審查檔案留在工作目錄，check_providers.py 只印出金鑰名稱，不會印出金鑰的值。

note.en: With --smoke, the script starts each found CLI and passes the prompt Reply OK only, with a 45 second limit.
note.zh: 加上 --smoke 時，腳本會啟動每個找到的 CLI，送入 Reply OK only，並以 45 秒為限。

caption.en: Without --smoke the script only reports which CLIs and key names it found, and it sends no prompt. With --smoke it starts the CLI you already installed and passes one short line. The scripts use the Python standard library only.
caption.zh: 沒有 --smoke 時，腳本只回報找到哪些 CLI 和金鑰名稱，不會送出提示。加上 --smoke 時，它會啟動你已經安裝的 CLI 並送入一句短文。這些腳本只用 Python 標準程式庫。

intro.en: render_report.py joins files that are already on disk. It does not call a model.
intro.zh: render_report.py 把磁碟上已有的檔案接起來。它不會呼叫模型。

note.en: The script reads input.md and final.md, then every round file in sorted name order, and it exits if a required file is missing.
note.zh: 腳本讀取 input.md 和 final.md，再依檔名順序讀取每個輪次檔；必要檔案缺了就結束。

note.en: report.md places final.md first, then input.md, then the rounds, with a rule between the parts.
note.zh: report.md 先放 final.md，再放 input.md，然後是各輪，各段之間有一條分隔線。

note.en: That joined Markdown is written to report.md in the review folder.
note.zh: 接好的 Markdown 寫入審查資料夾裡的 report.md。

note.en: report.html is a static page with a Print / Save PDF button, always marked zh-Hant, and print CSS hides the button and starts each part on a new page.
note.zh: report.html 是靜態頁，有 Print / Save PDF 按鈕，一律標成 zh-Hant；列印樣式會藏起按鈕，並讓每一段從新的一頁開始。

caption.en: The printable page opens with the verdict because final.md is joined first. Headings, lists, paragraphs, and inline code, bold, italics, and links are rendered. Tables and fenced code blocks are not supported, so they are not drawn as tables or code.
caption.zh: 可列印的頁面以結論開頭，因為接合時 final.md 在最前。標題、清單、段落，以及行內程式碼、粗體、斜體和連結會被轉成 HTML。表格和圍欄程式碼區塊沒有支援，所以不會畫成表格或程式碼。

intro.en: These are thinking styles, not separate models. The script only writes the four headings.
intro.zh: 這四個是思考風格，不是四個模型。腳本只寫出四個標題。

note.en: The Optimist heading is for the strongest version of the idea and why it could work.
note.zh: Optimist 這一段要寫出點子最強的版本，以及它為什麼可能成立。

note.en: The Skeptic heading is for weak assumptions, hidden costs, and reasons it could fail.
note.zh: Skeptic 這一段要寫出脆弱假設、隱藏成本，以及它可能失敗的原因。

note.en: The Pragmatist heading is for tests, an MVP shape, constraints, and trade-offs.
note.zh: Pragmatist 這一段要寫成可做的測試、MVP 的形狀、限制和取捨。

note.en: The Synthesizer heading is for the disagreement and for what evidence would change the conclusion.
note.zh: Synthesizer 這一段要整理分歧，並寫出什麼證據會改變結論。

note.en: init_review.py writes these four headings into every rounds/round-NN.md, and SKILL.md tells Claude to fill them.
note.zh: init_review.py 在每個 rounds/round-NN.md 寫入這四個標題，SKILL.md 再要 Claude 填上內容。

caption.en: Every round file is scaffolded with Optimist, Skeptic, Pragmatist, and Synthesizer, in that order. They are instructions for one Claude session, not four model calls. A missing provider can be simulated and labeled, but that label is not one of these four headings.
caption.zh: 每個輪次檔都會先放上 Optimist、Skeptic、Pragmatist、Synthesizer，順序固定。它們是給同一次 Claude 工作階段的指示，不是四次模型呼叫。缺少的提供者可以被模擬並標明，但那個標籤不是這四個標題之一。

intro.en: SKILL.md sets the round rules. The scripts do not check that Claude followed them.
intro.zh: 輪次規則寫在 SKILL.md。腳本不會檢查 Claude 有沒有照做。

note.en: Round 1 asks Optimist for the strongest case, Skeptic for the likely failure, Pragmatist for the smallest test, and Synthesizer for the decision tension.
note.zh: 第 1 輪要 Optimist 提出最有利的說法，Skeptic 指出可能的失敗，Pragmatist 提出最小的測試，Synthesizer 寫出決策上的張力。

note.en: After round 1, SKILL.md requires each personality to reference at least one earlier point from another personality.
note.zh: 第 1 輪之後，SKILL.md 要求每個個性至少回應另一個個性先前的一個論點。

note.en: In the final round each personality commits to build, validate, pivot, or stop.
note.zh: 最後一輪，每個個性要在做、先驗證、轉向或停止之中選一個。

caption.en: The return rail is the next round, and it stops after the chosen count of 5, 12, or 16. The last round's commitments are build, validate, pivot, or stop. final.md then records one verdict, worth_building, validate_first, pivot, or not_worth_building, plus a confidence from 0 to 100 and a kill criterion.
caption.zh: 回程代表下一輪，選了 5、12 或 16 輪就停。最後一輪的承諾是做、先驗證、轉向或停止。final.md 再記下一個結論：worth_building、validate_first、pivot 或 not_worth_building，以及 0 到 100 的信心和一條停止條件。
